blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court on Wednesday decided to reduce the number of votes needed to convict Vice President Sara Duterte. This came after the majority of the senator-judges voted to reduce the conviction threshold after both the defense and prosecution’s oral arguments on the matter.
